comment: Dependencies whose copyleft or odd licence was reviewed and accepted. scripts/licence_check.py reports these as WARN with the reason; anything not listed FAILs. Add an entry only with a ruling in docs/DECISIONS.md.

allow.name: pedalboard
allow.reason: GPLv3; allowed only behind the process boundary (native_host.py), until the project licence is chosen
allow.ref: docs/DECISIONS.md, pedalboard process boundary; docs/PLAN.md risks

allow.name: lameenc
allow.reason: LGPL-3.0-or-later MP3 encoder, unmodified, dynamically installed, never called; transitive dependency of demucs via the optional separation extra. Re-review before any bundled or frozen release

allow.name: soxr
allow.reason: LGPL-2.1-or-later resampler, unmodified, dynamically installed, optional separation-roformer extra, never bundled or frozen. Same terms as lameenc. Re-review before any bundled or frozen release
allow.ref: docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-14 cycle 3, RoFormer extra licence rulings (soxr accepted on lameenc terms; see also lameenc entry)

allow.name: certifi
allow.reason: MPL-2.0 weak copyleft, unmodified CA bundle; accepted as WARN
allow.ref: docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-14 cycle 3, RoFormer extra licence rulings

allow.name: diffq
allow.reason: CC BY-NC 4.0 non-commercial: acceptable for private local research use only while the project licence is undecided
allow.ref: docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-14 cycle 3, RoFormer extra licence rulings

allow.name: tqdm
allow.reason: MPL-2.0 AND MIT, weak copyleft, unmodified; accepted as WARN, same class as certifi
